item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. We believe commercial deep-sea mining will end battery-metal shortages. The minerals on the seafloor can help meet growing demand and secure the materials needed for batteries. It’s time to put this resource to work.

2. Battery-metal shortages are solvable. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will end them—and help ensure the materials needed for batteries are available when and where they’re needed. We’re ready to move forward.

3. We see deep-sea mining as the answer to battery-metal shortages. Commercial mining can unlock the metals needed to power batteries and meet demand. Let’s make use of this resource and end the shortage.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

Battery-metal shortages threaten our ability to build the batteries people and businesses need. We can end those shortages by beginning commercial deep-sea mining. Beneath the seafloor lies a major source of the metals needed for batteries, and bringing those resources into use will help meet demand. We believe the path forward is clear: develop deep-sea mining commercially and secure a reliable supply of battery metals. This is an opportunity to strengthen access to essential materials and support the technologies that depend on them. We’re ready to make the most of this resource. With commercial deep-sea mining, we can put an end to battery-metal shortages and help power what comes next.
